summary: Comprehensive E2E test of FreightOS Phase 1. Tested JRN-1 through JRN-25 (frontend-only, localStorage state) plus backend /api/openapi.json reachability. Core flows: first glance metrics, map city labels, truck markers/tooltips/panels, metric breakdown popovers, decision/call/booking/driver flow, idempotency with triple-click approve, reject/request-changes/take-over gating, Truck 102 risk, notifications (Needs you / Updates), reset confirm/cancel, persistence across reload, Fleet<->Dashboard nav, Schedule placeholder, voice listen+cancel, demo script popover, N-key suppression inside command-input. All critical acceptance criteria met.

critical_code_review_comments: Clean separation of services (dispatch/call/ai/voice/demo/runtime) and store; idempotency appears to be handled at the UI level (buttons disappear/re-render after first state transition) rather than via a transition guard in engine.js. Current observed behavior is idempotent but recommend adding an explicit guard keyed on offerId+action in engine.js for defense in depth.
maplibreAdapter city label testid is derived from name lower-cased with spaces to dashes → 'city-label-san-francisco'. If product spec expects 'city-label-sf', align either the testid or the spec.
No obvious MongoDB usage in backend (frontend-only state via localStorage key 'freightos-demo'), as intended for Phase 1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Call flow takes ~12s (7 transcript lines × 1.7s); after call, booking commit happens then driver instructions (1.8s) then ack (2.8s). Always wait ≥18s total after approve before asserting final state. metric-*-preview testids ONLY appear while booking-status-chip = 'Awaiting broker'. status-stepper lives inside decision-panel only; opening call-panel replaces it until 'Back to decision'. Use localStorage.clear() + reload (not just reload) before each independent journey.
